scope: Concrete native-pool assessment of the retained cast-cost limitations; documentation-only reconciliation

counted_cost_inventory.search_scope: Every tracked src/card_definitions/**/*.rs at fa543; literal ExileGraveyardCards searched in complete source bodies
counted_cost_inventory.native_use: Soaring Stoneglider uses ExileGraveyardCards(2) as its spell additional cost; it has no activated ability or mana production. That counted spell-cost path is supported by the shared cost transaction/planner.

native_graveyard_exile_examples.classification: Mana ability: tap and exile one graveyard card, then add mana.
Nonmana activation: exile an artifact or creature card to animate the source; it does not produce mana.
Mana ability: tap and exile one graveyard card, add red mana, and queue its separate reflexive ability.
Nonmana activation: pay mana, tap, and exile a creature card to create a token. Its separate index 0 activation taps for black mana and has no graveyard-exile cost.

counted_cost_inventory.supported_native_mana_shape: Molt Tender and Rubble Rouser have actual graveyard-exile mana abilities using ExileGraveyard, which the shared FundingMove external-cost path supports. Earthrumbler and Great Arashin City demonstrate nonmana graveyard-exile activations; their exile costs are not mana-child examples.

unsupported_synthetic_shape.details: The initial GRAVE_MANA fixture overrode Fanatical Firebrand with a mana ability whose additional cost was ExileGraveyardCards(1). Native Firebrand has no such cost. The inherited FundingMove external selection admits single ExileGraveyard and Sacrifice; counted external mana-child cost does not generate an incremental announcement. The retained corrected fixture uses supported ExileGraveyard and preserves both negative ancestor-reservation and positive extra-resource witnesses.

counted_cost_inventory.current_pool_impact: No native activated mana ability exposes the counted shape. A counted spell additional cost does not become a mana-ability cost through Dracogenesis, Behold, Delve, Harmonize, copied activated abilities or Sidisi funding. No known native TDM casting/activation route is hidden by this synthetic-only gap. This does not claim generic counted external mana-child support.

unsupported_split_card.name: Cease // Desist
unsupported_split_card.status: Outside TDM; Effect::Unsupported, one combined Instant//Sorcery catalogue entry, no separate split-half cast mapping. No full split-card/Songcrafter interoperability is claimed for this gated native card.

split_and_omen_assessment.mechanism: All13 TDM Dragon/Omen parents already have typed omen_spell links to separate chosen-face definitions. CastFace::Omen is independent of split halves. Free/Harmonize routes evaluate the cast-selected virtual definition and its own printed mana symbols/X, not the physical Dragon front.

qualified_face_proof.description: Actual announcements give a Dragon both Adventure and Omen non-Dragon faces. The Dragon main qualifies for Free; either non-Dragon spell face rejects. Generic cost machinery uses these same existing CastFace links.

split_and_omen_assessment.scope_boundary: The MKM split-half gap does not block the13 TDM Omen routes or selected Dragon qualification. Completing a gated Omen definition remains card authorship. Including unsupported Cease // Desist in a later whole-Standard interaction pool requires its split mapping and complete native behavior as a separate blocker.

verification: Read-only inventory of immutable published sources; no Cargo or changed consuming input. Source pins identify the exact assessed native pool. Parent accepted no speculative counted-child subsystem without a native obligation.
